title: pouteria brevipes
intro: Pouteria brevipes, commonly known as the Bolivian Brazil nut or Amazonian Brazil nut, is a plant species belonging to the family Sapotaceae. This tree is valued for its edible seeds, which are rich in nutrients and offer various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving heart health due to its high levels of healthy fats, protein, and fiber. The therapeutic actions of Pouteria brevipes include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which may help protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and neurodegenerative disorders. The bioactive constituents of Pouteria brevipes include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
